scope: Historical FBS moneyline probability and selection audit
evaluation_status: Reused historical validation; these seasons influenced earlier research and are not pristine holdouts.
sources: current core plus frozen v14 process correction under historical carryover priors
development_only_fits: spread probit location scale and weight
logistic calibration of market moneyline probabilities
selection: Frozen production 2-point gate and positive EV, one side per game; separately report best quoted provider and fixed Bovada provider; no synthetic spread or total odds; volume-floor sensitivity is moneyline-only and is not the full cross-market production floor.
uncertainty: Paired season-week block bootstrap, 5000 deterministic draws; report each evaluation season separately.
promotion: No production changes. Closing-price proxy profitability cannot establish executable betting returns without timestamped quotes. Probability improvement must beat direct moneyline market, not merely a weaker spread-to-probability baseline.
